headline: Jatim's Economy and Investment Slow, APINDO Warns of Risk from a Wave of Regulatory Pressure | beritajatim.com
summary: East Java's economic growth slowed to 5.72% in Q2 2026, and realised investment in the first semester contracted 2.6%. APINDO flagged regulatory uncertainty.
why: East Java is one of Indonesia's largest provincial economies, so its growth and investment trends feed into national economic data.
